hard: A workbook with a sheet per category. Every item has three prices, and which one applies depends on how many you buy.
Two price columns per item. One is the price, the other is an optional extra, and they must not be added together by default.
Prices are inside paragraphs and not in rupees. Read what is being offered on each line, not just the price.
A phone photo of a printed price list. Some lines are missing, and two items are priced by the pack.
A short email. The laptop prices are not written, they point at your last purchase order.
